name: Creation Challenge
description: Creation Challenge is a dataset featuring 2,000 diverse questions designed to evaluate large language models' ability to create their own tools, emphasizing the disentanglement of abstract tool creation and concrete decision execution.
reputation: A niche arXiv benchmark that has seen limited adoption outside the original paper, but is relevant for tool-creation and reasoning research.
notes: Emphasizes LLMs' tool creation ability and its impact on problem-solving; evaluated on math and tabular benchmarks.
